summary: Deleted the synchronous headless host (pub fn run_headless, pub fn run_stdio) that the binary never used. handle_command is now reachable only from the async host and keeps just the three commands that host answers inline (connection, handoff, resume status); the Prompt/Steer/Slash/UserShell/Tree/ToolOutput/InputQueue/Resources/Checkpoint/Mailbox/Status/Shutdown/Cancel/Approve/Project/resume-path arms that only the sync host reached are gone. The async dispatch arm is now an explicit or-pattern, so exhaustiveness is checked by the compiler. Every test that drove the sync host now drives run_async_streams through tests/support/sequential_host.rs (a client that writes each frame only after the previous request's terminal response, matching the sync host's one-at-a-time semantics), or run_async_streams directly for the writer-failure and lock-contention cases. Post-run Agent inspection (the async host consumes the Agent) is replaced by reopening the journal read-only (SessionStore::open_existing) or by an extra wire request (/approval, /reasoning, /model, connection status). Net -512 LOC (src/headless.rs -642).
